name: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd
title: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd - 539254 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Transmission-led capex ramp (FY27 guide INR21,000-22,000 crore, transmission ~15,500) with leverage held at 4.5x-4.7x; EBITDA growth depends on capitalisation of locked-in projects over 36-40 months.

capex.quote: we will have about INR22,000 crores of capex next year, of which transmission would be about 15,500

triggers.quote: we will have about INR22,000 crores of capex next year, of which transmission would be about 15,500

triggers.label: Transmission EBITDA 3x in 36-40 months

triggers.label: Tender market share 25-30%
